videos.description: The East Carolina Pirates visit the Army Black Knights for an NCAA Division I FBS American Conference game. East Carolina rides a three-game win streak with Emory Williams, while the Army Black Knights enter on a two-game skid with Cale Hellums.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Old Dominion Monarchs visit the UConn Huskies for an NCAA Division I FBS division game. Old Dominion defeated Coastal Carolina 21-8 on Nov. 7 with Quinn Henicle, while UConn defeated James Madison 46-22 on Nov. 14 with Kalieb Osborne.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The UNLV Rebels visit the San Jose State Spartans for an NCAA Division I FBS conference game. UNLV defeated New Mexico 21-17 on Nov. 14 with Jackson Arnold, while San Jose State lost 24-3 to Air Force on Nov. 14 with Luke Weaver in MWC.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Utah State Aggies visit the Oregon State Beavers for an NCAA Division I FBS game. Utah State lost 30-13 to San Diego State on Nov. 14 with Grady Brosterhous, while Oregon State enters on a three-game skid with Braden Atkinson in Pac-12.
